# Supplier-Hosted Administrative Access Governance

## Purpose

Govern high-impact administrative access to supplier-hosted services used by ORCHORDS.

## Requirements

Material administrative roles SHOULD be limited to justified users, protected with strong authentication, periodically reviewed, and removed promptly when no longer needed.

Where supplier support personnel can exercise equivalent privileged access, contractual and assurance expectations should address authorization, logging, and incident handling.
